note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts key engineering notes (Item 6 NFDS rating, System Voltage 120/240V) that Set A misses or misinterprets (Set A claims '3 W' for a 3-Wire system). Both sets struggle with the Wiring Schedule bindings due to OCR errors in the text layer (swapping specs between items like 20, 31, 32, 50), but Set B provides more accurate high-level equipment data and component identifiers (Items 4, 5, 6).
